description: Réservoirs d'eau potable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR. Dispositif destiné à collecter et stocker l'eau potable. Coverage: SIG-GR. The publisher named on the listing is SIG-GR. Its keywords include reservoir, geoportail-lu, eau-eau-potable, eau, grand-duche-du-luxembourg. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
